plain: On an episode with the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch famous in UFO circles for reports of strange events, podcast host Jesse Michels suggests that mountains around the world could be bases for aliens. He lists Mount Zeil in Australia, Mount Hayes in Alaska, Mount Perdido and Mount Shasta. If he is right, it would mean non-human beings are hidden inside or under mountains on several continents.
